name: dlm
description: Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager With Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager, you can manage the lifecycle of your Amazon Web Services resources.

subcommands.name: create-lifecycle-policy
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager lifecycle policy.

options.name: --execution-role-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role used to run the operations specified by the lifecycle policy

options.name: --description
options.description: A description of the lifecycle policy. The characters ^[0-9A-Za-z _-]+$ are supported

options.name: --state
options.description: The activation state of the lifecycle policy after creation

options.name: --policy-details
options.description: The configuration details of the lifecycle policy.

options.name: --tags
options.description: The tags to apply to the lifecycle policy during creation

options.name: --default-policy
options.description: [Default policies only] Specify the type of default policy to create.

options.name: --create-interval
options.description: [Default policies only] Specifies how often the policy should run and create snapshots or AMIs. The creation frequency can range from 1 to 7 days.

options.name: --retain-interval
options.description: [Default policies only] Specifies how long the policy should retain snapshots or AMIs before deleting them.

options.name: --copy-tags
options.description: [Default policies only] Indicates whether the policy should copy tags from the source resource to the snapshot or AMI.

options.name: --no-copy-tags
options.description: [Default policies only] Indicates whether the policy should copy tags from the source resource to the snapshot or AMI.

options.name: --extend-deletion
options.description: [Default policies only] Defines the snapshot or AMI retention behavior for the policy if the source volume or instance is deleted, or if the policy enters the e…

options.name: --no-extend-deletion
options.description: [Default policies only] Defines the snapshot or AMI retention behavior for the policy if the source volume or instance is deleted, or if the policy enters the e…

options.name: --cross-region-copy-targets
options.description: [Default policies only] Specifies destination Regions for snapshot or AMI copies. You can specify up to 3 destination Regions.

options.name: --exclusions
options.description: [Default policies only] Specifies exclusion parameters for volumes or instances for which you do not want to create snapshots or AMIs.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: create-default-role
subcommands.description: Creates the default IAM role  which will be used by Lifecycle service.

options.name: --iam-endpoint
options.description: The IAM endpoint to call for creating the roles. This is optional and should only be specified when a custom endpoint should be called for IAM operations

options.name: --resource-type
options.description: The resource type for which the role needs to be created. The available options are 'snapshot' and 'image'. This parameter defaults to 'snapshot'
